answer: For agents storing sparrow recordings from a walnut grove near the summit, pay for demonstrated storage capacity. Each paid replica must use a public-key-specific encoding and a Merkle commitment. Unpredictable block hashes select chunks; validators check timely inclusion proofs. Set deadlines shorter than the measured time to reconstruct a missing encoded replica. Ten aliases sharing one replica cannot answer ten independent challenges reliably. Earning ten storage allowances requires ten replicas, adding disk, encoding and bandwidth costs; names alone earn nothing.
